instruction: Put the cream cheese in the top drawer of the wooden cabinet, then close the top drawer of the wooden cabinet.
Put the cream cheese in the middle drawer of the wooden cabinet, then close the middle drawer of the wooden cabinet.
Put the butter in the middle drawer of the wooden cabinet, then close the middle drawer of the wooden cabinet.
Put the cream cheese in the top drawer of the wooden cabinet, then open the middle drawer of the cabinet.
Close the middle drawer of the wooden cabinet, then turn on the stove.
Turn on the stove, then put the butter on the top of the wooden cabinet.
Put the butter on the top of the wooden cabinet, then close the middle drawer of the wooden cabinet.
Put the cream cheese on the stove, then close the middle drawer of the wooden cabinet.
Put the chocolate pudding on the stove, then close the middle drawer of the wooden cabinet.
Put the cream cheese on the stove, then turn on the stove.
Put the chocolate pudding on the stove, then turn on the stove.
Put the chocolate pudding on the plate, then close the middle drawer of the wooden cabinet.
